title: You've Been Vibe Coding the Hard Way
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: I’ve vibe coded dozens of apps and tried all the tools.

- Claude Code may seem scary to start with, but I’ve never met a person who switched to Claude Code (or Codex), then decided to switch back to Stage 1 or 2 tools. You can still use Stage 1/2 tools for frontend
